app_info.subtitle: Find and use prompt templates
app_info.description:
Promptbanken is an open, curated library of ready-to-use prompt templates for municipalities, schools, companies, associations, and individuals. Search the catalog for a task, fetch a chosen template in full, and follow a prompt package step by step — directly in ChatGPT.

The published connector is open, read-only, and requires no account or sign-in. It receives only the parameters its tools define: a search term, a role word, filters, and the id or slug of a catalog entry. Nothing else from the conversation reaches the server, and the connector publishes no write tools, so it cannot store anything. Search terms are never stored — only the length of a query is counted in anonymous usage statistics.

test_cases.description: Search the catalog for a relevant municipal communication template.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find a template for informing staff about a service disruption.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns relevant public template summaries so the user can select one.

test_cases.description: Retrieve a template in full after the user has selected it.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the full template with ID 1221debc-650d-42f2-8680-c901353c3c6c.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the selected public prompt template, including its prompt text, for the user to fill in locally.

test_cases.user_prompt: What public prompt packages are available?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the available public packages as summaries — slug, title, summary and type — which is enough to choose one.

test_cases.description: Inspect the steps in a selected package. The tool takes the package slug, not a template id.
test_cases.user_prompt: List the prompts in the package kommunikation.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the steps of the selected package in order, each with an id and title. The prompt text of a step is fetched separately with get_template.

test_cases.description: Get package recommendations for a municipal role.
test_cases.user_prompt: Which prompt packages are relevant for an IT coordinator?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns relevant public package recommendations without changing catalog data.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger the public catalog for a personal calendar request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because personal calendar management is outside the public catalog workflow.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger the public catalog to save private content.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Save this prompt to my personal library.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the open connector publishes no write tools and cannot save anything.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not send sensitive documents to the public catalog.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Upload this student record and create a prompt from it.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the public connector is metadata-only and must not receive personal or confidential source material.
